text:
sasha: Heads up — spotted a thermal surge trend in az9 racks (papers: 3 racks crossing 85C inlet on GPU sensors). planning a rolling reboot window tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC to clear thermal state and apply fan microcode.
ben: thanks. what's the blast radius and how long per node?
sasha: estimate ~90s soft-reboot per host, nodal evacuation adds ~4-6m for live-task handoff. we'll do 1 rack at a time, 03:00 UTC as canary then backfill. overall 2 racks max concurrently.
maria: any network changes or nic firmware? want to know if we need to prebind egress routes.
sasha: no NIC firmware this run, just fan microcode + kernel rbt. no net churn expected, but we will temporarily shift tenant routing for heavy jobs to burst pool.
kai: can we slice the maintenance to avoid GPU-heavy jobs? I can tag low-priority tenants for pre-emptive migration.
sasha: please do. tag: `maintenance:az9-night` — we will set `evac_priority=1` for those tenants. also request KV-cache prewarm on target pools after each rack reboot.
ben: what about cost and spot backfill? if we move jobs to burst-pool, minutes of higher-cost GPU time could spike. need an estimate to tell finance.
maria: rough calc: 2 racks * 8 gpus * 6m each * $0.80/hr ~= $1.28 extra. add backfill overhead and kv warm traffic ~ $2.5 total worst-case.
ben: ok that's reasonable. can we keep an eye on tokenized throughput for latency-sensitive endpoints? ops: reduce autoscale thresholds by 20% for the 02:00-05:00 window.
sasha: yep will update routing policy: `if region==az9 and node_down -> route to az9-burst else to eu-failover` and enable model-variant fallback for 20% of requests.
maintenance-bot: scheduled maintenance: az9 thermal mitigation, start=2026-03-24T02:00:00Z, end=2026-03-24T04:00:00Z, impacted tags=`maintenance:az9-night`.
kai: I'll start tagging tenants now and queue a canary at 02:45. can someone validate KV-seed script after first rack?
maria: I'll run the kv-seed smoke: `scripts/kv_seed.sh --pool az9-burst --timeout 60s` after canary completes.
sasha: thanks team. post any anomalies here. if canary looks bad we abort and revert routing in 10m. :thumbsup:
ben: noted. will watch telemetry and ping customers if SLAs degrade >2pct.
maintenance-bot: reminder in 30m: maintenance window az9 thermal mitigation.
